mapper.select: WITH cycle AS ( SELECT cycle_id, qr_codes FROM recruitment_cycle WHERE cycle_id = #{cycleId} ), entries AS ( SELECT c.cycle_id, k.kind AS qr_type, 0 AS dept_id, JSON_EXTRACT(c.qr_codes, CONCAT('$.', JSON_QUOTE(k.kind))) AS item FROM cycle c JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(c.qr_codes), '$[*]' COLUMNS (kind VARCHAR(32) PATH '$')) k WHERE k.kind IN ('MAIN_GROUP','MAIN_GROUP_2','QA_GROUP') UNION ALL SELECT c.cycle_id,'DEPT', k.dept_id, JSON_EXTRACT(c.qr_codes, CONCAT('$.DEPT.', JSON_QUOTE(CAST(k.dept_id AS CHAR)))) FROM cycle c JOIN JSON_TABLE(JSON_KEYS(c.qr_codes,'$.DEPT'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (dept_id INT PATH '$')) k ) SELECT j.id,e.cycle_id,e.qr_type,e.dept_id,j.image_url,j.remark, FROM_UNIXTIME(j.created_at) AS created_at, FROM_UNIXTIME(j.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM entries e JOIN JSON_TABLE(e.item,'$' COLUMNS ( id INT PATH '$.id', image_url VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.image', remark VARCHAR(1024) PATH '$.remark', created_at BIGINT PATH '$.createdAt', updated_at BIGINT PATH '$.updatedAt' )) j ORDER BY e.qr_type,e.dept_id
